Overview

Accra is a city in Greater Accra with a population of 2,500,000. Ghana’s vibrant capital on the Atlantic coast, a fast-growing West African hub for business, culture, and diplomacy. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
